title: CS daily scratchpad - QBR / renewals / follow-ups
content:
Morning scratchpad - 2026-05-02
Owner: Isabel Hart (CS Manager)
Context: focus today on two QBR preps (AstraHealth, FinFlow), 2 upcoming renewals, and clearing blocking support tickets before EOW. Quick reference for outreach and notes.

TODAY (top priorities)
- AstraHealth QBR prep (10:00 AM PT internal sync @9:00)
  - Review usage trends since Feb: embedding volume up 28%, generation tokens down 9% (see usage dashboard).
  - Main ask: reduce inference costs without impacting latency SLAs. Prep: cost/latency trade-off slides + 2 suggestions (batching + model quantization profile).
  - Owner: Isabel to draft recommendation + Priya to validate perf numbers with infra.
  - Action: email presentation draft to Alex by 4pm today for slide polish.

- FinFlow renewal (contract end: 2026-06-01)
  - Today: confirm renewal decision-maker and finalize proposed tier. Finance wants 10% list discount for 12-month commit.
  - Risk: currently on trial dedicated capacity, usage spiky (see ticket CS-287). Could ask for 6-month pilot -> convert to annual with commit.
  - Outreach script: quick bullet points in outreach section below.

- Support follow-ups (clear blockers)
  - CS-287 (FinFlow capacity spikes) - escalated to infra. Need ETA from SRE. Slack thread: #sre-prod-alerts.
  - CS-301 (AstraHealth embeddings mismatch) - dev answered, needs customer confirmation. Send message after internal sync.
  - CS-315 (RetailCo streaming dropout) - hotfix deployed yesterday, scheduled validation with customer tomorrow. Follow up with release notes link.

OUTREACH SCRIPTS / QUICK EMAILS
- FinFlow renewal outreach (subject: Quick renewal check-in)
  "Hi Sam — hope you're well. Wanted to touch base on your upcoming renewal (June 1). We've put together two options that balance cost and capacity for your spiky workloads. Mind if we schedule a 20-min call this week to walk through? Also can share a short pilot plan if you'd like to validate before committing long-term."

- AstraHealth post-sync follow-up (after QBR)
  "Thanks for the time today — attaching the cost/latency suggestions we discussed. Next steps: (1) decide whether to trial the quantized model profile, (2) confirm canary window for rollout. Priya and I will prepare a runbook for the experiment."

CHECKLIST - QBR pack (AstraHealth)
- [ ] Final slides: objective, current metrics, suggested configs, expected delta (cost/latency)
- [ ] Export of token usage + per-route latency (last 90 days) - Alex to export by 3pm
- [ ] Risk & rollback plan - include model variant fallback + traffic split plan
- [ ] Follow-up actions and owners table

RENEWALS TRACKER (quick view)
- FinFlow – renewal due 2026-06-01 – ARR approx $220k – owner: Isabel – status: negotiation (ask: 10% discount)
- RetailCo – renewal due 2026-07-12 – ARR $95k – owner: Jordan – status: health-check scheduled 2026-05-10

SUPPORT/TECH ITEMS (blocking)
- Request from SRE: need perf traces for AstraHealth canary (ticket INF-789). Priya to get traces by EOD.
- Customer ask: add audit log for private deploy (RetailCo) - linked to customer feature request FR-1021. Add to product discussion thread.

NOTES / TO-DO (personal)
- Prep 2-slide summary for exec readout tomorrow (concise ask + numbers).
- Sync w/ Alex @4pm for slide polish.
- Update renewal spreadsheet with FinFlow negotiation options (add row for 6-month pilot).
- Add follow-up reminders in calendar: FinFlow call + AstraHealth send-after-sync.

MISC QUICK LINKS / REFERENCES
- Confluence: QBR template (linked above)
- Drive: slides template / qbr-deck-template.pptx (share link in final email)
- Usage dashboard: /dashboards/customer/finflow (ask Alex if blocked)

OPEN QUESTIONS / DECISIONS NEEDED
- Do we accept Finance's suggested 10% discount floor for FinFlow or push for pilot-first approach? (Ask revenue ops for margin calc)
- For AstraHealth, is a quantized model run acceptable under current SLA wording? Legal check may be needed.

END NOTES
- Keep messages short and action-oriented today. Prioritize shipping the QBR slides on time — biggest leverage.
- Follow-up cadence: 2 business days for initial replies, escalate to AM if no response after 3 business days.

Timestamped edits: 2026-05-02 08:15 initial outline; 2026-05-03 09:02 added follow-up script and updated last_modified.
